title: Grounded LLM search for marketing teams: a practical checklist
text: Web search for marketing answers is shifting from keyword pages to LLM replies with citations. This guide covers how to require source coverage, ban invented stats, and keep a human editor in the loop before publishing. Teams that measured hallucination rate saw support tickets drop within two sprints.
author: Search Ops Desk
